versions.changelog: 新增分享录音与知识库录音查询，完善配对安装、凭证续期和本机连接修复。
同步 GitHub 完整技能源码；固定使用 AideNote 3.2.0 macOS/Windows 安装脚本及校验值；完善一键配对和设备身份重置。
Use immutable versioned bridge artifacts so existing and new installations remain verifiable.
Add account device enrollment support and reset device identity only during explicit repair or reauthorization.
Keep one-time App pairing SAFE under Hermes security audit by using explicit environment allowlists.
Add one-time App pairing and automatic verified bridge installation without manual API Key copy.
新增经 SHA-256 验证的一键本机连接套件安装，自动配置 Hermes API、tunnel、MCP、bridge 与登录自启动，并完善安装状态校验。
首个 Hermes 原生版本：支持录音、详情、待办、知识库与本机 bridge 状态查询；增加本地安全凭证配置和真实 API 调用脚本。
